Enemy Appearance |active_in = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies have double health.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Double Health''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] which gives the enemies double health. It is only available in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Effects== When activated, '''Double Health''' will make every enemy have double health. Additionally, these enemies will have green cross appear out of them, though while this may look like health regeneration being also applied, this is purely visual. Additionally, it causes the [[Bloated]] attribute to be applied twice, resulting in an enemy having eight times the normal health, instead of the expected four. For example, the [[Nuclear Monster]] will have 12,000,000 HP, instead of the expected 6,000,000 HP. This is most likely a bug. ==Trivia== *This modifier actually existed in the game for years, being exclusive to admins, though it was never publicly available until the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode released. ==Update History== *'''4 July 2022''' - [[v1.2.5]] **'''Double Health''' added, being exclusive to administrators. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Double Health''' added, exclusively appearing in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} Health gained from '''Double Health''' deals no damage to units, making units kill enemies instantly if the enemy's base health is gone. **{{Bug}} Bloated applies twice with the '''Double Health''' modifier, resulting in 8x the normal enemy health with both on. {{ModifierNavBox}}
